questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(13, 234, 9)

(15, 180, 6)

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is:** (1st number × 3rd number × 2) = 2nd number

(13, 234, 9)

13 × 9 × 2 = 234

234 = 234 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(15, 180, 6)

15 × 6 × 2 = 180

180 = 180 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one

Option 1) (14, 196, 7)

14 × 7 × 2 = 196

**196 = 196 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 2) (12, 108, 9)

12 × 9 × 2 = 108

216 ≠ 108 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (16, 240, 5)

16 × 5 × 2 = 240

160 ≠ 240 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (17, 340, 5)

17 × 5 × 2 = 340

170 ≠ 340 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '(14, 196, 7)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the daughter of B'

A - B means 'A is the wife of B'

A × B means 'A is the brother of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, if 'P + Q × R - S ÷ T', which of the following is true?

options.text: P is the daughter of T's Mother's Brother.
Q is the brother of S.
P is the sister of T.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9WrMX2PxUUiuc23xtLzIYfAm-irKB4b57QlaLQLGdZfRiZezLGmE-LDNzE8Cwo2irGS7CWeUw-nY5zMYIdWPZre6UsWnYjv1MpUAVRhIwEu2rYK0rb8Zv1_QSlVCu5fvDClEGTgVIIgUmbHNzoyQcd8-5?key=Pg8w9VmbvKrHmQxFZbtW-g] 

**Decoding the Symbols:**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
−

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

**Given:** P + Q × R - S ÷ T

P + Q → P is the daughter of Q.

Q × R → Q is the brother of R. 

 

R - S → R is the wife of S.

 

S ÷ T → S is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cef68f34a31be71697238c05b62643a909063bfb19117c83f486a83cb026f15.png] 

Thus, according to the final family tree:

**Option 1)** **P is the daughter of T's Mother's Brother → Correct**

Option 2) T is S's Son → Incorrect as T can be either the son or daughter of S, therefore cannot be determined.

Option 3) Q is the brother of S → Incorrect as Q is the brother-in-law of S.

Option 4) P is the sister of T → Incorrect as P is the cousin of T.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

⇒ 15 - 2 + __**13 ÷ 13**__ × 3 = ?

⇒ 15 - 2 + __1____** × 3**__ = ?

⇒ __**15 + 3**__ - 2 = ?

⇒ __**18 - 2**__ = ?

⇒ **16 = ?**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 19 July 2012 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 January 2018?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 19 July 2012 is Thursday

The number of odd days from 19 July 2012 to 11 January 2018 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2012
 19 July 2012 - 31 December 2012
 12 July + 31 August + 30 September + 31 October + 30 November + 31 December = 165 days
 165 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2013 - 2017
 Full years (4 Ordinary years + 1 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 4 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 1 Leap years) = 6 odd days
 6
 
 

 2011
 1st January 2011 - 11 January 2018
 11 January = 11 days
 11 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 Total odd days
 (14 ÷ 7) = **0**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 19 July 2012 to 11 January 2018 ⇒ 0

⇒So, Zero odd days will be added to Thursday because the day is asked in future.

∴ Thursday was the day of the week on 11 January 2018.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All jams are butter.

Some nibs are ink.

Some nibs are butter.

**Conclusion (I): **Some ink is butter.

**Conclusion (II):** All jams are nibs.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b989411dca836c5a103d578deffe4239338c54d63c5431c3ccc2485e8bc6278e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some ink is butter → Does not follow (As some nibs are ink and some nibs are butter. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. All jams are nibs → Does not follow (As all jams are butter and some nibs are butter. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
